name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard captures 'Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up' (holding_box on the very next step is exactly a pickup, since box_fell and holding_box never hold together). Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard captures 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands': reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is added, and since at_exit holds only on the last step the response demands the box on that step. Both clauses trace to task sentences, priorities are hard as worded, all propositions are declared, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task states only conditional requirements.

texts: If the box falls, the agent must pick it up so that the box is held on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be holding the box at the exit.
